user_request: Hop, tu peux intégrer et passer au le suivant.
scope: Three cog propulsion equipment icons. Cog armament separately approved and integrated.
charter: Native painted embossed miniature UI glyphs, bronze/silver/gold, single mast and vertical sail progression, no engines.
prompts:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: ONE Victoria 3 naval designer COG PROPULSION equipment UI glyph, not a scene or complete ship.
Image 1 STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: native painted embossed metal UI icons, simple broad shapes and restrained thin dark bevel outline.
Subject: a SINGLE vertical wooden mast with square sail rigging, a small plain mast foot, no hull and no water. Three-quarter very slightly angled view, nearly frontal so vertical sail arrangement is obvious. Compact centered complete silhouette with generous margins. Readable at 32px, no tiny detailed ropes or diagram.
Palette: ALL parts including fabric and mast monochrome metallic BRONZE color, broad painted shading; not realistic colored fabric. Genuine transparent empty background and gaps, opaque subject interiors, no external glow, no haze, no shadow, no backdrop, no text, no people. No engines, propellers, paddle wheels, additional masts or horizontal multiplication of sails. This is a game PM/equipment icon with coherent straight mast and yard geometry.
LOW tier warm metallic BRONZE: ONE mast and ONE large broad square course sail hanging from ONE horizontal yard. Plain billowing square sail with a gently concave lower hem, no reef bands and no upper sails. Very few thick rigging lines. Broad readable bronze single-sail silhouette.

qa.visual_inspection: All three full-size generated outputs and 180px/64px/32px comparison inspected. One broad square sail, two thick reef bands with short ties, then smaller topsail above course sail on same mast. Distinct monochrome tier palettes.
qa.limitations: Many partially transparent pixels in generated masters; preserved without painting or alpha retouch. Stylized illustrative symbols, not historical rigging plans.

integration_note: Exact approved bronze/silver/gold masters integrated. Only three icon bindings changed; speed bonuses, goods, technologies, names and fleet configurations unchanged. Original alpha preserved without retouch.
